text:
Nina Zhao: saw a 0.29% spike in funcall parse errors on the latest int8 canary. raw stream shows merged fragments splitting inside unicode escapes and boolean literals.
Omar Reyes: sample please
Nina Zhao: snippet:
```
[replica-1] ...\"flags\": {\"is_admin\": tr
[replica-2] ue, \"beta\": false} ...
```
Naive concat sometimes yields `tr\nue` or an extra backslash and json.loads fails.
Caleb Kim: interesting edge-case: repair lib previously auto-closed the token and produced `true` which masked a case where model had emitted `null` intentionally (bad).
Omar Reyes: we need two things: (1) no model contract change: add lightweight fragment metadata anchors (CRC16 of last 12 bytes) so arbiter can detect unsafe joins, (2) a delimiter-mode fallback: arbiter inserts an out-of-band delimiter `~rw~` between fragments so caller can split reliably if needed.
Nina Zhao: agree. plus a repair-audit mode: when repair runs, store original_chunks + repaired_text + ops to an audit queue (scrubbed). periodically compare against sampled non-streaming full-response to detect masking. policy: if mask_rate > 0.15% disable repairs for that canary.
ops-bot: delimiter+anchor canary deployed to eng-ml staging (5387654330) at 2% traffic :rocket:
audit-bot: repair-audit queue enabled (sample rate 1/50 repairs) :lock:
Caleb Kim: reassembly heuristic we plan to ship:
```
def reassemble(chunks, metadata):
  if anchors_compatible(metadata): return concat(chunks)
  candidate = conservative_fix(concat(chunks))
  if candidate and passes_sanity(candidate): return candidate
  return None  # trigger non-streaming retry
```
Omar Reyes: telemetry plan: emit `anchor_mismatch`, `delimiter_fallback_used`, `repair_attempted` (fixed|abstain|failed), `repair_mask_candidate`. tag with model+quant+canary.
Nina Zhao: I'll add a dashboard slice with mask_rate by model and a small eval comparing parsed args pre/post repair. if repaired items get flagged, we'll back out repairs asap.
Caleb Kim: also add frag-ttl 160ms to avoid cross-response merges.
Nina Zhao: thanks  will post first-hour metrics here. :thumbsup:
